Hi Liz / Evan,

Thanks again for the time earlier — attached is the pilot proposal we discussed (synapse_proposal_v3.pdf). The proposal shows a three-month pilot at a tiered rate and an example rate-cap for the POC. High level:
- Month 1: onboarding + initial 1M tokens at $0.0012/token
- Months 2–3: ramped usage with blended rates and an optional rate-cap of $0.00095/token if Synapse commits to a 6-month follow-on contract

Key asks from our side: confirmation of expected token profile (inference vs. embeddings), procurement lead for paperwork, and whether a short-term NDA is needed for the logging/E2E spec.

I've copied our SE (Prioym for technical follow-up). Let me know if you want a quick refresh call next week after you review.

Subject: Fwd: Synapse pricing ask — request for exception guidance

Marissa / Jordan / Priyom — forwarding Synapse's counter. TL;DR: they want ~40% off list + an explicit rate-cap of $0.00075/token for the POC. They'd sign a longer commercial if we move price.

Why this matters: Synapse is strategic in the payer-provider segment — expected ARR (post-pilot) is ~ $1.2M ARR within 12 months per my forecast (conservative). Short term unit economics will look weak if we take 40% off without guardrails.

Possible options for an exception (my proposals):
- Option A (least risk): Offer 30% off list for the 3-month pilot. If they convert to a 12-month committed contract within 90 days, provide a retro credit to bridge to 40% for the first 6 months.
- Option B (middle ground): Approve 40% off + $0.00075 rate-cap for the pilot in exchange for a 12-month minimum commitment ($500k ARR target) and a $50k professional services onboarding fee.
- Option C (aggressive): Approve 40% now with strict usage floors and an upfront prepayment that protects unit economics (requires CFO sign-off).

Request: I need signoff path for >30% discount or a formal exception memo to the CFO. Jordan — can you please run a quick unit-econ / threshold write-up? Priyom — please prepare a short technical appendix on caching and expected token profile so we can model cost.

Thanks — want to keep momentum with Synapse; they expect a response by end of week.

—Camila
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com

Forwarded attachment: synapse_proposal_v3.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-18T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Synapse pricing ask — unit econ sketch attached

Camila / team — ran an initial unit-econ for the pilot and 12-month follow-on scenarios. Attached is a quick spreadsheet (synapse_unit_econ.xlsx). Highlights:

- Baseline list-rate blended equivalent: $0.00125/token.
- 40% off list -> effective rate $0.00075/token -> gross margin at expected profile: ~18% (below our target of 28–32%).
- 35% off + $500k commit -> effective rate ~$0.0008125 -> gross margin ~24% (closer to acceptable with usage floor).

Recommendation: We can approve up to 35% discount on a case-by-case basis if accompanied by a 12-month minimum commitment ($500k ARR target) and a binding minimum spend. Anything >35% requires CFO sign-off (Markus).

If Marissa and Markus are ok, I can bake the conditional credit language into the term sheet.

Attachments: synapse_unit_econ.xlsx (cost model, 6 tabs)

—Jordan
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Request: Exception approval — Synapse Health (Deal SV-2026-197)

Markus —

As discussed, Synapse is asking for a 40% discount and an explicit pilot rate-cap at $0.00075/token. Deal background in one line: strategic payer-provider prospect, pilot -> potential $1.2M ARR post-conversion.

What I'm requesting: an exception approval for commercial terms outside of standard discount thresholds. Proposed ask: APPROVE 40% for the 3-month pilot with the following mandatory conditions to protect margin:
- 12-month minimum commitment if they continue post-pilot (minimum $500k ARR).
- Binding minimum spend for the pilot period (non-refundable portion of $75k).
- $50k professional services onboarding fee to cover deployment integration and prompt engineering support.
- Automatic rollback clause: if usage profile deviates by >25% (token mix), pricing will be rebalanced to the 35% band.

If you prefer a lower-risk path, Jordan's recommendation (attached) is to approve 35% with the $500k commit. I am neutral on the final band but want a clear signal to the customer by EOD Friday.

Please reply with one of the options below and I'll communicate to Synapse immediately:
- APPROVE 40% with the listed conditions
- APPROVE 35% with $500k commit (Jordan rec)
- DENY exception — offer 30% pilot only

Attached: synapse_proposal_v3.pdf, synapse_unit_econ.xlsx

Thanks for a quick review — I appreciate it.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
